# Image fixture provenance

`nasa-astronaut.png` is the NASA Eileen Collins image distributed by scikit-image 0.25.2. Scikit-image documents it as public domain, with no known copyright restrictions. Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/scikit-image/scikit-image/v0.25.2/skimage/data/astronaut.png . License/provenance: https://scikit-image.org/docs/stable/api/skimage.data#skimage.data.astronaut . Original NASA collection: https://flic.kr/p/r9qvLn . SHA-256 is recorded in the parity report and fixture manifest.

This image is used only to test face detector tensor/box/landmark parity. The application does not identify the person. Repeated or transformed copies are correlated samples and do not establish population accuracy, visibility precision, or the required held-out evaluation corpus. NASA marks and likeness are not used for product endorsement.
